recommendations.title: Improve Overall Health
recommendations.recommendationText: Focus on improving nutrition, physical activity, sleep, hydration, and stress management one step at a time.
recommendations.whyThisMatters: Improving overall health requires consistent healthy lifestyle habits across multiple areas.
actionSteps: Focus on improving nutrition, physical activity, sleep, hydration, and stress management one step at a time.
expectedBenefits: Better health, improved quality of life, and increased vitality.

recommendations.title: Rebuild Daily Energy
recommendations.recommendationText: Improve sleep quality, hydration, balanced nutrition, and regular movement throughout the day.
recommendations.whyThisMatters: Healthy energy supports productivity, exercise, mood, and long-term wellbeing.
actionSteps: Improve sleep quality, hydration, balanced nutrition, and regular movement throughout the day.
expectedBenefits: Higher daily energy and better focus.

recommendations.title: Reduce Fatigue
recommendations.recommendationText: Prioritize recovery through quality sleep, hydration, balanced meals, and stress reduction.
recommendations.whyThisMatters: Persistent fatigue often reflects lifestyle habits that require improvement.
actionSteps: Prioritize recovery through quality sleep, hydration, balanced meals, and stress reduction.
expectedBenefits: Reduced fatigue and improved daily functioning.

recommendations.title: Improve Daily Function
recommendations.recommendationText: Increase daily movement gradually while supporting recovery through healthy nutrition and sleep.
recommendations.whyThisMatters: Improving physical wellbeing helps everyday activities become easier and less tiring.
actionSteps: Increase daily movement gradually while supporting recovery through healthy nutrition and sleep.
expectedBenefits: Improved physical capacity and independence.

recommendations.title: Balanced Nutrition
recommendations.recommendationText: Eat regular meals containing whole grains, vegetables, fruits, quality protein, and healthy fats.
recommendations.whyThisMatters: Balanced nutrition supports energy, immunity, recovery, and overall health.
actionSteps: Eat regular meals containing whole grains, vegetables, fruits, quality protein, and healthy fats.
expectedBenefits: Better nutrition and improved overall wellbeing.

recommendations.title: Increase Physical Activity
recommendations.recommendationText: Aim for at least 150 minutes of moderate physical activity each week, progressing gradually.
recommendations.whyThisMatters: Regular movement supports heart health, energy, metabolism, and mental wellbeing.
actionSteps: Aim for at least 150 minutes of moderate physical activity each week, progressing gradually.
expectedBenefits: Improved fitness and long-term health.

recommendations.title: Improve Sleep
recommendations.recommendationText: Maintain a consistent sleep schedule and create a relaxing bedtime routine.
recommendations.whyThisMatters: Sleep is essential for recovery, energy, mood, and overall health.
actionSteps: Maintain a consistent sleep schedule and create a relaxing bedtime routine.
expectedBenefits: Improved recovery and better daytime energy.

recommendations.title: Improve Hydration
recommendations.recommendationText: Drink enough fluids throughout the day to meet your personalized daily water goal.
recommendations.whyThisMatters: Proper hydration supports nearly every function in the body.
actionSteps: Drink enough fluids throughout the day to meet your personalized daily water goal.
expectedBenefits: Improved concentration, energy, and physical wellbeing.

recommendations.title: Reduce Sitting
recommendations.recommendationText: Stand, stretch, or walk briefly every 30–60 minutes.
recommendations.whyThisMatters: Long periods of sitting increase health risks even in people who exercise.
actionSteps: Stand, stretch, or walk briefly every 30–60 minutes.
expectedBenefits: Better circulation, posture, and daily movement.

recommendations.title: Safe Sunlight Exposure
recommendations.recommendationText: Spend short periods outdoors regularly while following safe sun practices.
recommendations.whyThisMatters: Appropriate sunlight exposure supports healthy daily rhythms and overall wellbeing.
actionSteps: Spend short periods outdoors regularly while following safe sun practices.
expectedBenefits: Improved daily routine and wellbeing.

recommendations.title: Manage Stress
recommendations.recommendationText: Practice relaxation techniques such as deep breathing, mindfulness, walking, or meditation.
recommendations.whyThisMatters: Managing stress improves both mental and physical health.
actionSteps: Practice relaxation techniques such as deep breathing, mindfulness, walking, or meditation.
expectedBenefits: Reduced stress and improved emotional wellbeing.

recommendations.title: Support Emotional Health
recommendations.recommendationText: Make time for enjoyable activities, supportive relationships, and healthy coping strategies.
recommendations.whyThisMatters: Emotional wellbeing influences every aspect of overall health.
actionSteps: Make time for enjoyable activities, supportive relationships, and healthy coping strategies.
expectedBenefits: Improved emotional resilience.

recommendations.title: Build Health Routines
recommendations.recommendationText: Begin with one small healthy habit and build gradually over time.
recommendations.whyThisMatters: Healthy routines are more sustainable than relying on motivation alone.
actionSteps: Begin with one small healthy habit and build gradually over time.
expectedBenefits: Improved long-term consistency.

recommendations.title: Improve Work-Life Balance
recommendations.recommendationText: Protect time for family, hobbies, exercise, and recovery.
recommendations.whyThisMatters: Balancing work and personal life improves wellbeing and reduces stress.
actionSteps: Protect time for family, hobbies, exercise, and recovery.
expectedBenefits: Better mental health and reduced burnout.

recommendations.title: Relax Regularly
recommendations.recommendationText: Schedule regular relaxation or leisure time every week.
recommendations.whyThisMatters: Recovery is essential for long-term wellbeing.
actionSteps: Schedule regular relaxation or leisure time every week.
expectedBenefits: Improved resilience and lower stress.

recommendations.title: Strengthen Social Connections
recommendations.recommendationText: Spend more time connecting with supportive family, friends, or community groups.
recommendations.whyThisMatters: Healthy social relationships contribute to better emotional and physical wellbeing.
actionSteps: Spend more time connecting with supportive family, friends, or community groups.
expectedBenefits: Greater emotional support and improved wellbeing.

recommendations.title: Schedule Routine Checkups
recommendations.recommendationText: Schedule regular preventive health screenings appropriate for your age and health profile.
recommendations.whyThisMatters: Routine health check-ups help detect problems early.
actionSteps: Schedule regular preventive health screenings appropriate for your age and health profile.
expectedBenefits: Earlier detection and better long-term health outcomes.

recommendations.title: Respond To Health Changes
recommendations.recommendationText: Seek professional medical advice if symptoms persist or worsen.
recommendations.whyThisMatters: Paying attention to early warning signs supports timely care.
actionSteps: Seek professional medical advice if symptoms persist or worsen.
expectedBenefits: Reduced risk of delayed diagnosis.

recommendations.title: Build Wellness Confidence
recommendations.recommendationText: Set small, achievable wellness goals and celebrate progress regularly.
recommendations.whyThisMatters: Confidence helps maintain healthy behaviours over time.
actionSteps: Set small, achievable wellness goals and celebrate progress regularly.
expectedBenefits: Greater self-belief and long-term success.

recommendations.title: Strengthen Commitment
recommendations.recommendationText: Commit to following your personalized wellness plan consistently for at least 90 days.
recommendations.whyThisMatters: Long-term success depends on sustained healthy habits.
actionSteps: Commit to following your personalized wellness plan consistently for at least 90 days.
expectedBenefits: Greater habit formation and lasting health improvements.

recommendations.title: Start Small
recommendations.recommendationText: Choose one realistic improvement this week before adding additional goals.
recommendations.whyThisMatters: Major lifestyle changes are more successful when built gradually.
actionSteps: Choose one realistic improvement this week before adding additional goals.
expectedBenefits: Reduced overwhelm and greater consistency.

recommendations.title: Maintain Healthy Lifestyle
recommendations.recommendationText: Continue maintaining your healthy routines while making gradual improvements where appropriate.
recommendations.whyThisMatters: Your current habits provide an excellent foundation for long-term health.
actionSteps: Continue maintaining your healthy routines while making gradual improvements where appropriate.
expectedBenefits: Sustained wellness, healthy aging, and improved quality of life.
